# coralogix_integration (Resource)

A Coralogix Integration. Check https://coralogix.com/docs/developer-portal/infrastructure-as-code/terraform-provider/integrations/aws-metrics-collector/ for available options.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    coralogix = {
      version = "~> 3.0"
      source  = "coralogix/coralogix"
    }
  }
}

provider "coralogix" {
  #api_key = "<add your api key here or add env variable CORALOGIX_API_KEY>"
  #env = "<add the environment you want to work at or add env variable CORALOGIX_ENV>"
}

resource "coralogix_integration" "example" {
  integration_key = "aws-metrics-collector"
  version         = "0.1.0"
  # Note that the attribute casing is important here
  parameters = {
    ApplicationName  = "cxsdk"
    SubsystemName    = "aws-metrics-collector"
    MetricNamespaces = ["AWS/S3"]
    AwsRoleArn       = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/example-role"
    IntegrationName  = "sdk-integration-setup"
    AwsRegion        = "eu-north-1"
    WithAggregations = false
    EnrichWithTags   = true
  }
}

resource "coralogix_integration" "aws-resource-catalog" {
  integration_key = "aws-resource-catalog"
  version         = "0.1.0"

  parameters = {
    IntegrationName = "aws-resource-catalog"
    AwsRoleArn      = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/S3Access"
  }
}

# A parameter that carries a secret goes in parameters_wo rather than parameters: Terraform
# sends it to Coralogix and never writes it to state. Use an ephemeral variable for the value.
# Increment the matching version to send a rotated secret. A key is in parameters or in
# parameters_wo, not in both.
#
# variable "integration_secret" {
#   type      = string
#   sensitive = true
#   ephemeral = true
# }
#
# resource "coralogix_integration" "with_secret" {
#   integration_key = "example-integration"
#   version         = "0.1.0"
#   parameters = {
#     IntegrationName = "example"
#   }
#   parameters_wo = {
#     SecretParameter = var.integration_secret
#   }
#   parameters_wo_versions = {
#     SecretParameter = 1
#   }
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_key` (String) Selector for the integration.
- `parameters` (Dynamic) Parameters required by the integration. A parameter that carries a secret, such as an API key, belongs in `parameters_wo` instead, so its value is never written to state. Keep `parameters` as an object, and leave it empty (`{}`) when every parameter is in `parameters_wo`.
- `version` (String) The integration version

### Optional

- `parameters_wo` (Map of String) Parameters whose values are secret, keyed by parameter name. Terraform sends the values to Coralogix as string parameters and never writes them to state. Every key needs a matching entry in `parameters_wo_versions`, and a key here must not also appear in `parameters`. Terraform never stores a write-only value, so it cannot detect that the secret changed: increment the version of a key to send a rotated secret. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Importing brings the values into state, because an import has neither configuration nor prior state to say which parameter is managed this way; one apply afterwards removes them again, so treat an imported secret as exposed and rotate it.
- `parameters_wo_versions` (Map of Number) Version of each `parameters_wo` entry, keyed by the same parameter name. Increment a version to send a rotated secret. These versions are kept in state and are not secret.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Integration ID.
